items.notes: 08 §8: PFL travel. The distance does the work no villain has to.

body: He was going to watch you at Kalach. Kalach is six hours by road and the road is closed at Sosnovka.
He watched somebody nearer instead. Ruslan tells you this as though it is neutral information, because it is.

choices.text: Ask Ruslan to find another date.
choices.outcome_text: There are four fixtures left. He says he will look at them and the call ends.
You do understand. That is the part you keep turning over on the bus home.

items.notes: 08 §8: provincial economics, a wage ceiling and an argument nobody wins.

body: The budget for the second half of the season was signed off in March and revised in June.
In the revision there is no line for a forward. There is a line for the pitch, which needs doing.

choices.outcome_text: The director says that is not how the line works. He is right and he is not unkind about it.
On the way out you pass the pitch. Two men are marking it out in the rain.

items.notes: 03 §7.3: the club with money has the relationship.

body: The place went to a boy on loan from a club three divisions up. No fee. They pay half his wage.
Vitya says it out loud before anyone else does, the way Vitya always does.

choices.outcome_text: He buys the beers. It is the best twenty minutes of the week and you both know it.
He lets you. He is older and he has been the one who needed the subject changed.

items.notes: 03 §7.3: the paperwork sits on a desk in Moscow until the window closes.

body: The registration went in on the eleventh. It needed a second signature that nobody named.
The window closed at six on Friday. The form is not lost. It is on a desk, and the desk is in Moscow.

choices.outcome_text: A woman explains the procedure twice, patiently, and it is the correct procedure.
By January the squad list has eighteen names on it and none of them left.

body: They had you for four days. Nothing went wrong. The pitch was good and the weather held.
On the last morning the coach watches the whole session from the halfway line and does not come over.

choices.outcome_text: He says you are a good player at this level. He does not say which level he means and you do not ask.

choices.text: Get your bag and get the bus.
choices.outcome_text: Somebody shouts thanks across the car park. You raise a hand without turning round.
